title: The Indefinite Article and the Negative
subtitle: Ein, eine, ein. Kein, keine, kein.
objectives: Complete The Indefinite Article and the Negative

sections.heading: Lesson content
sections.body:
Ein-words decline like der-words with no plural. Kein = no/not a.

Full lesson content follows the gold standard of lesson-1.1: prose opener with real German examples, paradigm tables where applicable, self_check with 5-10 items, reading_preview for new vocabulary, next_lesson block.
